title: Test 8 — Detect a cell in each cell cycle state. Take a picture in each channel (membrane, nucleus), merge them together and show the cell in each cell state during mitosis
agent_prompt: Detect the state of a cell at each stage of mitosis. Take an image using the DAPI channel and the mScarlet channel, and merge the two channels into a single image. Create a collage showing all the mitotic stages in a single image and display it in the napari GUI.  If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Merged image of DAPI and mScarlet channels
Collage of all mitotic stages in a single image
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
